question: Should generic tool-progress intent be a permanent public Plugin SDK contract, or remain a narrower bundled Codex-to-Slack seam?
rationale: The fix expands third-party API surface, and repository policy requires explicit owner intent for the permanent contract boundary rather than treating a convenience export as settled API.

options.title: Approve and document public intent
options.body: Keep the generic marker and predicate, define producer and channel semantics, and add focused public-contract documentation and tests.

options.title: Use a private bundled seam
options.body: Remove the public SDK exports and carry progress intent through a narrower approved internal or plugin-local boundary.

recommendation.title: Approve and document public intent
recommendation.body: Keep the generic marker and predicate, define producer and channel semantics, and add focused public-contract documentation and tests.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged history ties this owner to both native Slack delivery architecture and public Plugin SDK contract decisions.
